title: Picking (this customer) and saving clears the default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B in Edit Customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click "Change" beside "Bill Invoices To" on the left card.
  3. Click the "Bill Invoices To" field.
  4. Pick "[customer A's name] (this customer)".
  5. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer B's name.

Step 2:

  • The "Bill Invoices To" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The first option reads "[customer A's name] (this customer)".

Step 4:

  • The field shows "[customer A's name] (this customer)".

Step 5:

  • The window closes.
  • Customer A's left card no longer shows a "Bill Invoices To" line or "Change".

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R5: “The field's first option is "[customer] (this customer)"; picking it and saving clears the default.”
  • S1-N1: “A customer that bills itself shows no "Bill Invoices To" line and no way to set one on the card; the default is set in New Customer or Edit Customer (Story 2).”
  • Key Decisions: “Bill To shows only where it differs from the customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
